results.name: two devices of one member and a distinct member share the household
a notice made on the card with colour, list and a shrunk photo reaches every device
notes can be dragged, overlap, and the last one touched comes to the front
the arrangement scales with the board at phone and desktop widths
anyone can unpin a notice: it leaves the board but stays in the module
the module lists every notice newest first and anyone can pin one back to the board
only the author or an administrator can delete
Search finds notice text (including list items) and opens the notice; Add creates one
after a full restart while offline the board loads, and offline create, move and tick survive another restart
reconnect delivers every queued change without conflicts and every device agrees
a stale offline edit is surfaced for review and the shared version stays on screen
no horizontal overflow at 390, 768 and 1440 px and no page errors
